title: Let praise and insult lose their claim
summary: Freedom begins when praise and slander stop moving the center. Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: Freedom begins when praise and slander stop moving the center.
source.lifeApplication: After praise or criticism lands, let the line level the room before opinion does.
